triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: CANON is a distinct RFC 8785 leaf (code-unit key order, preserved JSON null, sha256:<64-hex>) whose output differs from digestCanonicalJson and canonicalJsonForSigning on frozen vectors, proven differentially.
acceptanceBindings.note: Foundation canonicalizer + its un-gameable differential proof.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The 14-key policySnapshot resolves to the spec's verbatim defaults digesting to a frozen sha256 literal, and fails closed with a distinct named diagnostic on every §1.12 floor, missing/relative pinnedPath, unknown key, forbidden env key, invariance catch-all/tracked-material glob, and unresolvable argv placeholder.
acceptanceBindings.note: Fail-closed resolver + config type; the direction of the invariance rule is proven both ways.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: lattice doctor emits exactly one non-gating red-evidence policy line (resolved policyDigest or the fail-closed diagnostic) while its exit code and proofstory_gate_check output stay byte-identical.
acceptanceBindings.note: The live, non-gating consumer that makes the leaf observable to the operator.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: No new string overclaims beyond the §0.6 assurance tier and the smoke is registered in validate.commands with the uncommitted-policy rule pinned.

diagnosticGaps.message: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured.
